company.name: LumiShare
company.shortDescription: IllumiShare is a blockchain-based digital asset management ecosystem.
company.description:
LumiShare
 is a renewable energy financing platform transforming how solar and wind infrastructure projects are funded through Real-World Asset (RWA) tokenization. By converting renewable energy assets into compliance-focused, investable on-chain products, LumiShare enables institutional and eligible investors to access yield-generating sustainable infrastructure through blockchain-enabled financial markets.

At the core of the ecosystem is LumiPlace
, the company’s end-to-end RWA issuance and investment platform. LumiPlace manages the full lifecycle of renewable infrastructure investments, including project origination, due diligence, structuring, tokenization, and distribution. This infrastructure connects verified renewable energy developers with global capital markets while enabling non-custodial participation in clean energy investments.

LumiShare’s platform is designed to provide transparent legal structuring, programmable cash flows, and long-term secondary market potential for tokenized infrastructure assets. Through blockchain technology and digital asset frameworks, the company aims to improve accessibility, liquidity, and efficiency in renewable energy financing.

Supporting the intelligence layer of the ecosystem is WoozyAI
, LumiShare’s AI-driven optimization and digital twin engine. WoozyAI analyzes live production metrics, grid performance data, and equipment telemetry to refine yield forecasting, detect operational anomalies, and generate actionable insights that enhance asset performance while reducing operational and investment risk.
